verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs directly describe Organizations as a first-class multi-tenant primitive with default admin/member roles, custom roles/permissions, multi-org membership with active-organization session context, and UI for creating orgs, switching accounts, and viewing memberships/invitations. This covers the core of orgs+memberships+invitations out of the box, though the invitation flow itself is only implied via a marketing snippet rather than a dedicated invitations doc excerpt, and no independent hands-on report specifically validates the invitation UX. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party doc excerpt on the invitation flow itself, and independent/community corroboration that the org+invite flow works smoothly in production.
